products.body_html:
"Great things come packed in the low calorie Zespri SunGold™ Kiwifruit. 
 
Gloriously golden yellow and juicy sweet, just one Zespri SunGold™ Kiwifruit gives you 100% of your daily vitamin C needs to support your immunity. Surprised? 
 
Be further blown away with this mighty Zespri SunGold™ Kiwifruit, as it’s power-packed with more than 20 feel-good vitamins, minerals, enzymes and polyphenols, including antioxidants vitamins C, E and A,  dietary fibre, potassium and folate. Taste the goodness today!
 
The Zespri brand is recognised as the world leader in premium quality kiwifruit.  All Zespri Kiwifruit are non-GMO.

Usage Instructions

  • Wash kiwi before cutting
  • Slice in half and scoop the flesh, or peel and cut into slices or cubes
  • Add to fruit salads, smoothies, breakfast bowls, desserts, or lunchboxes
  • Use as a fresh garnish for cakes, tarts, yogurt bowls, or fruit platters

Care Instructions

  • Store firm kiwi at room temperature until it reaches preferred ripeness
  • Refrigerate ripe kiwi to help keep it fresh
  • Store cut kiwi in an airtight container in the refrigerator
  • Use within a suitable freshness period for the best flavor and texture

 

Enjoy a distinctive kiwi variety with Zespri Kiwi Sungold New Zealand 500g. This 500g pack features Zespri SunGold kiwi from New Zealand, combining a recognized fruit brand with the convenience of a manageable household pack. Fresh Market Dubai lists this product within its Zespri fruit selection.

SunGold kiwi is known for its golden interior and smooth eating experience, making it an appealing choice for fresh snacking, breakfast bowls, fruit salads, smoothies, desserts, and colorful fruit platters.

The convenient 500g pack of Zespri SunGold Kiwi makes it easy to keep fresh fruit available for breakfasts, lunch boxes, entertaining, or everyday snacks.

Wash the kiwi before cutting.

Slice the fruit in half and scoop out the flesh with a spoon, or peel and cut it into slices or cubes depending on how you plan to serve it.

Enjoy fresh on its own or add it to yogurt, cereal, breakfast bowls, smoothies, fruit salads, desserts, or fruit platters.

For recipes containing other fresh fruits, add the kiwi shortly before serving when appropriate to maintain its fresh appearance and texture.

Care Instructions

  • Store according to the fruit's ripeness.
  • Firmer kiwi can be kept at room temperature while ripening.
  • Refrigerate ripe fruit to help maintain freshness for longer.
  • Keep cut kiwi refrigerated in a covered food-safe container.
  • Handle carefully to minimize bruising.
  • Consume cut fruit promptly.

 

Frequently Asked Questions

1. What is Zespri Kiwi Sungold New Zealand 500g?
It is a 500g pack of Zespri SunGold kiwi fruit from New Zealand, suitable for fresh eating and a variety of fruit-based recipes.

2. What brand is this SunGold kiwi?

SunGold is a golden-fleshed kiwi variety with a distinctive appearance that makes it suitable for snacking, breakfast dishes, fruit salads and desserts.

According to the product listing, the fruit is sourced from New Zealand.
